title: Drum Mode (Digitone MIDI track drum sequencer)
author: morriess
description: Drum Mode turns a Digitone mk1 MIDI track into an 8-lane drum sequencer on the track's own MIDI channel. 0.3, live lanes with assignable notes: DRUM MODE in the Mod Menu (hold a track key) toggles it for the active MIDI track; trig keys 1-8 play the 8 lane notes (GM drum map by default) on the track's channel, several at once; hold a pad and turn A to set its note, B its velocity; the screen's corner shows the lanes and the held pad's note. Saved with the project. It names no firmware address, so its OS 1.44 port is empty. Needs core-dn1 5.3.
